propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui per sanctum Josephum Confessorem tuum, ad erudiendam spiritu
intellegentiae ac pietatis juventutem, novum Ecclesiae tuae subsidium
providere dignatus es: praesta, quaesumus; nos, ejus exemplo et
intercessione, ita facere et docere, ut praemia consequamur aeterna. Per
Dominum nostrum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Altare tuum, Domine, muneribus cumulamus oblatis: ut ejus nobis fiant
supplicatione propitia, cujus nos donasti patrocinio adjuvari. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Josepho Confessore tuo, ad majus semper proficiamus pietatis incrementum.
Per Dominum.
